body.statement: For every sequence in \(\mathcal P_n\), including sequences with \(H\to\infty\), \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{bc}}-\tau=-L+o_{\mathbb P}(s)\), \(\widehat V/s^2\to_{\mathbb P}1\), and the primitive conditional block-dependence and score-diffuseness conditions yield \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_n}\sup_{z\in\mathbb R}|\mathbb P_P\{(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{bc}}-\tau)/\sqrt{\widehat V}\le z\mid M,\Omega\}-\Phi(z)|\to0\). Consequently, \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal P_n}\mathbb P_P\{\tau\in\mathrm{CI}_{1-\alpha}\mid M,\Omega\}\to1-\alpha\). This strictly extends Choi and Yuan (2024), Theorem 3.1, for the same native subgroup estimator from \(q=0,H=1\) to fixed \(q\ge1\), growing \(H\), and a feasible nonzero curvature correction.
body.justification: The derived dependency-graph limit and feasible studentization convert weak-signal deterministic-MNAR completion into implementable inference for a sustained causal effect.
body.gap: Choi and Yuan cover a one-date independent-noise subgroup average; Cen and Lam cover residual HAC for loading scores; Su, Wang, and Wang cover regression coefficients from alternating maximization.
body.consumer: The confidence interval directly supports a reanalysis of the SEC Tick Size Pilot's average sustained liquidity effect over the realized treated cohort and post window.

obligation.what_is_open: The native expansion, feasible curvature and influence-weight plug-in rates, and conditional score limit needed for studentization and uniform coverage.
obligation.obstruction: Causal cancellation and variance-consistency algebra are exact, but the frozen core does not prove the native second-order theorem, and its unconditional tail condition is insufficient for the stated conditional uniform central limit theorem.
obligation.attempted: Derived the exact causal error identity, decomposed the corrected estimator, and proved a Toeplitz-operator bound reducing variance consistency to covariance and weight consistency. The remaining inputs coincide with the separately isolated obligations.
obligation.partial_result:
The causal algebra is exact.  By consistency and the common-start mask, \(Y^{\mathrm{obs}}_{it}=Y_{it}(1)\) on \(G\times W\); hence the definitions of \(\tau\) and \(\widehat\tau\) give
\[
 \widehat\tau-\tau
 =-\frac1{gH}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}(\widehat M_{it}-M_{it}).
\]
If the native expansion holds, then
\[
 \widehat\tau_{\mathrm{bc}}-\tau
 =-L-(Q-B_2)-R_{\mathrm{agg}}+(\widehat B_2-B_2).
\]
Thus the remainder statements in the native-transfer theorem imply \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{bc}}-\tau=-L+o_{\mathbb P}(s)\).

There is also an exact variance-consistency reduction.  Let \(d=\widehat w-w\) and let \(\Gamma_q\) and \(\widehat\Gamma_q\) be the banded Toeplitz matrices generated by \(\gamma\) and \(\widehat\gamma\).  Fixed \(q\), sub-Gaussian second moments, and \(\Delta_\gamma=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\) imply bounded operator norms, and
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 |\widehat V-s^2|
 &\le \lVert\widehat\Gamma_q\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}
 \left(2\lVert w\rVert_F\lVert d\rVert_F+\lVert d\rVert_F^2\right)
 +\lVert\widehat\Gamma_q-\Gamma_q\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\lVert w\rVert_F^2\\
 &\le C_q\left\{\lVert w\rVert_F\lVert d\rVert_F+\lVert d\rVert_F^2+\Delta_\gamma\lVert w\rVert_F^2\right\}.
 \end{aligned}
\]
Score diffuseness gives \(\lVert w\rVert_F^2=O(s^2)\), so \(\lVert d\rVert_F^2=o_{\mathbb P}(s^2)\) yields \(\widehat V/s^2\to_{\mathbb P}1\).  Conditional Slutsky and the conditional score limit would then prove the displayed studentized limit and Wald coverage.  The two missing premises are the native optimizer and plug-in rates and, for the conditional limit as written, the proposed conditional tail assumption.
